name: FEJKA Artificial potted plant, indoor/outdoor monstera, 7 ½ "

dimensions.raw: Diameter of plant pot: 7 ½ "; Height of plant: 35 ½ "
dimensions.source: IKEA Measurements section, read in Chrome 2026-10-22; no Width or Depth row, so w and d are the pot's diameter (the leaves spread wider; the page gives no spread), h is the Height of plant row

notes: Flags: fits. A floor plant, artificial: no soil for Maddie to dig and no watering. Its leaves spread beyond the 7 1/2" pot, so it stands where a brushed leaf does no harm. Comes in a black plastic pot; the page offers a 7 1/2" water hyacinth plant pot as an add-on (natural texture, not captured). Only 1 left in IKEA Long Island, NY on 2026-10-22. Floor-size alternatives on the search list, not opened: FEJKA bamboo 8 1/4" and bird of paradise 9", $89.99 each (Best seller). New; not badged. rooms: back-bedroom, from the staging brief.
